caption:
The video captures an indoor pool divided into parallel lanes by yellow and blue lane ropes, where several swimmers are mid-stroke as the excerpt opens. Each repeats a breaststroke-style cycle, lifting head and shoulders as the arms sweep outward, then reaching the arms forward as the body dips lower into a glide. A steady rightward pan slides the ropes, deck, and background leftward across the frame, while the swimmers translate rightward through the water, away from the starting blocks seen at the left edge at first.

The foreground swimmer in a dark cap and the middle-lane swimmer in a white cap each hold their own lane, keeping a consistent spacing along the pool as they glide and pull. Splashes and ripples rise and fade around them in step with each stroke cycle, while upper-lane swimmers follow the same rhythm. On the deck, two figures remain present, walking along it as the pan carries the wall clock and starting blocks out of view while the steps stay at the right edge. The excerpt ends with the swimmers still stroking. No one reaches a wall or stops within the visible portion.
relations: Swimmers repeat a breaststroke cycle, sweeping arms outward then reaching forward into a glide.
The rightward camera pan slides the lane ropes and deck background leftward across the frame.
Splashes and ripples emerge around the swimmers during their stroke, fading as they glide.
Swimmers maintain consistent lane spacing while translating rightward through the water away from the starting blocks.
